library.label: Show the glyph library when a font opens
library.help: The docked sidebar lists every character the font encodes. It is read a page at a time, as far as you scroll.

guides.label: Show metric guides
guides.help: Ruled lines for the font's own ascender, cap height, x-height and descender.

sample.label: Specimen text
sample.help: Left empty, the sample is picked from what the font covers.

typeSize.label: Type size
typeSize.help: The size the specimen line is drawn at.

settings.label: 打开时显示字库侧栏
settings.help: 侧栏按 Unicode 区块列出字体编码的全部字符，打开后才按页读取，滚动到哪读到哪。

settings.label: 显示度量参考线
settings.help: 按字体自己的上伸、大写高、x 高与下伸数值画出的标线。

settings.label: 示例文本
settings.help: 留空时按字体覆盖的字符自动挑选。

settings.label: 字号
settings.help: 打字样本那一行的字号。
